conversation_before_the_call.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

I'm sorry you're dealing with this — I can help. To look up your cards and either unlock or reset PINs I first need to verify your identity.

Quick overview of what I need and next steps:
- I must confirm any 2 of these on file: date of birth, email address, phone number, or mailing address. After verification I’ll look up the debit cards on your account and follow the appropriate PIN-unlock or reset steps.
- Because you said multiple cards are locked, I’ll need to check all cards on the account before making changes — if any card has a security hold or recent fraud indicators, we may need to escalate to our security team.

If you want to proceed, please tell me:
1) Which identifier should I use to look you up (Rho-Bank user ID, email address, or full name)? (Note: name lookups are case-sensitive.)
2) Which two pieces of information from the list below can you confirm for verification? Pick any two: date of birth, email, phone number, or mailing address.

Once you provide the lookup identifier, I’ll pull your record and ask you to confirm the two fields you picked. Sound good?
